rule: Points every 5 deg of true anomaly nu on the same median orbit (Brown & Batygin 2021), ranked by the time the planet spends there per degree of nu (proportional to r^2, Kepler's second law: aphelion first, as in run 1). Going down that list, a point is taken if it lies >= 6 deg from the centre of every strip already searched (F1-F5, F2L) and of every point already taken, |b| >= 20 deg and >= 3 seasons with >= 45 D1-D3 exposures in the index (same exposure rule as run 1), until 5 points are taken. Strips: 110 rows x 2040 columns, as run 1.
